sentences.text: If you run aground, stop the engine and check everyone for injuries.
Before trying to move, check the bilge and hull for leaks, because backing a holed boat off a shoal can sink it in deeper water.
Don’t just back hard: you can pull sand and mud into the engine’s cooling system and make things worse.
Try shifting weight, carrying an anchor out to deeper water and pulling yourself off, which is called kedging, or simply waiting for the rising tide.
Remember that an unintended grounding of a commercial vessel is a reportable marine casualty.
